name: EOSE WP-MVP-0003 Start Bootstrap

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - eose/start-wp-mvp-0003-bootstrap

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  start:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout current main
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Start WP-MVP-0003 and stabilize projections
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          git switch -c eose/start-wp-mvp-0003

          ./scripts/eos start WP-MVP-0003 \
            --by 'Thomas Carter' \
            --reason 'Begin governed EOSE execution of WP-MVP-0003 after EOSP authorization merged through PR #202.'

          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0001 --profile wp
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0002 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0004

          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import json
          state = json.loads(Path('.eos/state/current.json').read_text())
          assert state['entities']['WP']['WP-MVP-0001']['lifecycle_state'] == 'CLOSED'
          assert state['entities']['WP']['WP-MVP-0002']['lifecycle_state'] == 'CLOSED'
          assert state['entities']['WP']['WP-MVP-0003']['lifecycle_state'] == 'IN_PROGRESS'
          assert state['entities']['WC']['WC-MVP-0001']['lifecycle_state'] == 'ACTIVE'
          wp = Path('engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0003.md').read_text()
          assert '**Status:** IN_PROGRESS' in wp
          PY

          git status --short
          git diff --stat
          git diff -- engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0003.md
          git diff -- .eos/work-packets.tsv

      - name: Commit start transaction
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          git config user.name 'PMB CI'
          git config user.email 'ci@pmb.test'
          git add -A
          git commit -m 'chore(eose): start WP-MVP-0003'

      - name: Post-commit stability proof and push
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/eose/start-wp-mvp-0003
